nodes.label: Goose Game Icon
nodes.description: 800x800px SVG icon depicting a stylized cartoon goose with a rounded gray body, amber/brown beak and feet, elliptical dark eyes, and decorative chest/belly coloring. Used as the desktop icon for the Goose Game feature in the GooseOS Win95-style environment. Sourced from SVG Repo via the SVG Repo Mixer Tools generator.
